THE DETAILS

Find out more. Whenever you choose.

The key benefits come first. Expand any topic for more about our contracts, production, technology and investment opportunities.

01 Contracts & offtake Ten years of product offtake and larvae supply

We have a signed ten-year offtake agreement covering the products and quantities specified in the contract. The supply of the required larvae eggs is likewise covered by a ten-year agreement.

Feed provision is organised. Our procurement and sales structure therefore rests on long-term contractual relationships. We discuss the detailed terms confidentially with interested investors.Detailed terms, including volumes, quality specifications and prices, are discussed confidentially with interested investors.

02 Locations & infrastructure Flexible options for industrial production

FLYWEISS has several possible locations, including suitable factory buildings and production facilities, from which to choose. We assess technical, economic and logistics criteria when selecting the most suitable site.

This approach combines industrial infrastructure with business flexibility.

03 Production concept Biological efficiency meets industrial processes

The production concept focuses on black soldier fly larvae, with a short biological development cycle and versatile biomass.

Rearing, hygiene, quality assurance, processing and logistics are designed as an integrated industrial process.

04 Machinery & technology Automated production and clear responsibilities

Modern production machinery with a value of approximately EUR 9 million is planned for the project. The specialist machinery partner provides and installs the machines. Under the project arrangements, the machines remain the partner’s property and are covered by insurance and warranty agreements.

FLYWEISS is responsible for integrating the machines into the wider technical infrastructure and organising ongoing operations.

05 Energy & operations In-house expertise and an ambition for grid independence

Martin Holzer and Andria Mitić are responsible for the wider technical infrastructure: solar and energy systems, cooling, climate control, ventilation, water supply and operational coordination.

Our energy strategy is designed to enable production without reliance on the public electricity grid.

06 Products & markets Protein, feed ingredients and additional value creation

FLYWEISS focuses on protein- and fat-rich raw materials from larval biomass for suitable animal-feed applications.

Beyond this, ingredients for cosmetics, collagen-related products and bio-based adhesives offer additional opportunities for value creation and future market diversification.

Applications depend on processing, quality and applicable approvals. The technical and commercial feasibility of obtaining pure collagen from the selected larvae must be verified before a product commitment. Cosmetic and adhesive applications are development potential, not existing production or separate offtake agreements.

Insect frass is planned as a second product from the production process. Its subsequent use will depend on the relevant quality, processing and legal requirements.

07 Equity & investment Percentage ownership interests available

FLYWEISS offers capital partners the possibility of a direct percentage equity stake in the company. The percentage, investment amount, governance rights and any distribution terms are agreed individually.

Based on the current project plan, funding of approximately 60% of eligible investment costs is being targeted. Eligibility and approval remain subject to the relevant authorities.We share details of the project, investment structures and financing confidentially with prospective investors.
